_doc: Ground-truth labels for Agent Mapper eval. One entry per clip file under tests/agent_mapper/clips/<env>/. Use environment_type values from schemas/scene_context.schema.json. The acceptable_environment_types array lets a prediction count as correct if it falls in a list of close alternates (e.g. estate_gate vs estate_street).
